nativeDependencyContract.optionalCryptoKey: Do not reference CryptoKey::class_ unless explicit existing builtin_web_crypto target dependency is configured. If absent, isCryptoKey remains an identifiable deferred callable; do not silently import entropy or retain crypto code. Measure final guest bytes/imports for optional variant.
nativeDependencyContract.scriptedProxy: Before GetBuiltinClass/typed-buffer/weak-map predicates, reject js::IsScriptedProxy for all non-proxy checks; revoked scripted proxies are true only for isProxy. No target/property/tag reads.
nativeDependencyContract.memory: Classification only: no ArrayBuffer data borrow, ownership transfer or hidden live-resource read. Root JSObject across fallible helpers; do not put MayGC calls in a no-GC scope.

futureCapabilities.arguments: Only separately selected wasi:cli/environment@0.2.10 get-arguments for omitted parseArgs args; explicit args is pure guest.
futureCapabilities.environment: debuglog NODE_DEBUG selection requires explicit environment policy; parseEnv(content) itself requires none.
futureCapabilities.stdio: Active warning/log output requires separately selected standard wasi:cli/stderr or stdout plus wasi:io/streams/error as emitted; log timestamp additionally wall-clock if promised. No process PID service is introduced.
futureCapabilities.initialProfile: No external host interfaces for selected pure operations; deferred defaults do not grant capabilities.
